description: What is the average rent for a 2-bed in Dublin 4, or in an Irish town? Paid ($0.02 USDC): town or Dublin postal-district rent, bedroom/type filters and 4- and 12-quarter trends. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/rent-check. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
